source.interpretation: MissionType.SYACF accepts Y or N and defaults to Y. Y directs an in-mission system with a critical failure to abort immediately; N permits continuation until mission completion or another stop condition. It also applies to noncritical failures escalated by NCFTL or MAXNC, outside this pair. SYACP is a distinct PM option.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both child arms differ from accepted D08.var01 default only in the RISK-MISSION SYACF null-to-Y or null-to-N cell and description; the pair differs only in the SYACF Y/N cell and description, retaining failure exposure, seed, schedule, repair, stock, PM and resource configuration.

Each arm must run in guarded session-0 SSH with Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, preserve GUI PID 13340 identity, roundtrip all authored row-containing tables, have zero converter errors, and produce nonempty SXO, event log and JSON report. All warnings and notes must be interpreted; any diagnostic showing SYACF ignored blocks acceptance.

The explicit-Y arm is expected to repeat the accepted parent's critical failure near h22.6835 and abort the RISK mission. The explicit-N arm must observe a critical failure during that mission but continue operation afterward rather than immediately abort; its exact mission completion/success status, return, repair and PM sequence must be read from native evidence.

Reconcile individual critical-failure and mission events, direct repair, one-worker booking, calendar PM, report bins, mission summary and terminal readiness for both arms. A single seed does not establish a general failure-clock or mission-abort law.
Seal source, invocation, closure and native raw artifacts; obtain a separate read-only reviewer replay without importing author validation.
limits: One fixed-seed, two-aircraft, item-free traditional OPHOURS system with one late critical fault in a fixed RISK mission only.
No claim for other failure times, noncritical NCFTL/MAXNC escalation, continuous or extendable missions, critical PM/SYACP, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
Full D08 and Issue #18 remain open.
